comments.author: sunny
comments.body:
Review of https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/168 at 9c74bbae537bee07d3d4deb1013d2206983c6523 by codex/gpt-6.1-sol: CHANGES REQUESTED.

1. [P2] Keep the New Data Root button visible while the D switcher scrolls (`src/tui/shell/DataRootList.tsx:114`, composed by `src/tui/shell/DataRootSwitcher.tsx:167`). Moving `newRow` above the roots only pins it when DataRootList's own finite `limit` handles scrolling. The switcher supplies no limit, and `ModalFrame.tsx:98` wraps the entire list in `ScrollBody`; wheel/Page Down scrolling or automatic reveal of a lower highlighted root therefore scrolls the button out of view. Opening the switcher with a sufficiently low current root can hide it immediately. The PR's Notes acknowledge this behavior, but it does not meet ROW-85's requirement for a button pinned above the known roots in both surfaces, or ADR-0056 §1's statement that the known roots scroll below it. Keep the button outside the scrolling roots viewport (or bound the roots list to the available modal height while preserving its controls), and verify a long list with a low current root plus keyboard and mouse scrolling.

Reviewed the full diff and touched files, initial/default/current selection, -1 button navigation, search/no-match behavior, missing-last ordering, click and wheel handlers, ADR-0056's amendments to ADR-0055/0042, guide and skill updates, and the four byte-identical reference copies. Verified both retained launch receipts: this distinct reviewer worker/thread mcp:1fbd07a3-84e2-4f00-85d0-59ca9550e0bf uses codex/gpt-6.1-sol; the implementing worker uses claudeAgent/claude-opus-5-5, and its record accounts for both product/docs commits and the main merge at this head. All six screenshot URLs return HTTP 200. GitHub's six current-head checks are completed SUCCESS. No product or Board changes were made.

Independent local validation: pnpm typecheck PASS; pnpm lint PASS; pnpm test:unit PASS (79 tests); pnpm test:cli PASS (21 tests).

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Review of https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/168 at 88db9395489cf1c84ee34117171ce65d75deb92d by codex/gpt-6-astra: CHANGES REQUESTED.  1. [P2] Keep the button pinned when rows wrap or the terminal is short (`src/tui/shell/DataRootList.tsx:69-71`, with `rowHeight={2}` in `DataRootSwitcher.tsx:178`). The new budget assumes every DataRootRow is two lines, but its label and status text wrap in SelectListRow. At 120x30 with 14 roots and the current root last, labels such as "Root 13 customer development and production environments with shared engineering projects" make each row three lines. Opening D then immediately scrolls the outer Modal ScrollBody to "5–19 of 20", completely hiding + New Data Root. Separately, at 100x20 even short labels reproduce the problem: the modal body has six lines, but Math.max(1, ...) forces one root plus five chrome lines (seven total), so automatic reveal scrolls to "2–6 of 7" and hides the button. Both were reproduced with the built exact-head CLI through agentic-tui. Keep the button outside the scrolling viewport, or make the sizing account for actual rendered row heights and insufficient body space, so neither automatic reveal nor Page Up/Down or wheel scrolling can remove it. Verify wrapped labels and a 20-row terminal as well as the existing 120x30 short-label case. This is the prior pinning finding still reproducible after the repair, contrary to ROW-85 and ADR-0056 §1.  Fresh full-PR review covered the entire diff and touched files, ModalFrame/ScrollBody layout and focus reveal, initial default/current selection, button navigation, search/no-match behavior, missing-last ordering, click/wheel handlers, page navigation, guide/skill updates, ADR-0056 amendments and index, and the four byte-identical reference copies. Real-terminal checks confirmed the short-label 120x30 switcher keeps the button visible during Page Up/Down and wheel navigation, no-match search selects the button, and the startup picker initially selects the default with Arrow Up reaching the button. No additional blocking findings.
